title: Requirement 1
text: Customers can place orders that contain one or more order lines.

title: Requirement 2
text: Each order is placed by exactly one customer.

title: Requirement 3
text: Every order line references exactly one product and stores quantity.

title: Requirement 4
text: Products must have a SKU code, name, and unit price.

title: Requirement 5
text: Orders have an order date and a status value.

title: Requirement 6
text: Payments are linked to one order and store amount, method, and timestamp.

title: Requirement 7
text: A successful payment updates the order payment status to paid.

title: Requirement 8
text: Customers may have multiple delivery addresses.

title: Requirement 9
text: Each shipment is associated with exactly one order.

title: Requirement 10
text: Shipments store carrier name, tracking number, and ship date.

title: Requirement 11
text: A warehouse stores one or more inventory records.

title: Requirement 12
text: Inventory records connect a product to a warehouse with available quantity.

title: Requirement 13
text: Inventory quantity cannot be negative.

title: Requirement 14
text: Returns are linked to the original order and one customer.

title: Requirement 15
text: A return includes reason text and return date.

title: Requirement 16
text: Discount coupons have code, discount type, and discount value.

title: Requirement 17
text: An order may apply zero or more coupons.

title: Requirement 18
text: Customer accounts store email and registration date.

title: Requirement 19
text: Email values should be unique per customer account.

title: Requirement 20
text: Products belong to exactly one category.

title: Requirement 21
text: Categories can have a parent category for hierarchy.

title: Requirement 22
text: Suppliers provide one or more products.

title: Requirement 23
text: Each product is sourced from at least one supplier.

title: Requirement 24
text: Orders with total amount above a threshold require fraud review.

title: Requirement 25
text: Fraud reviews keep reviewer id, decision, and decision time.

title: Requirement 26
text: Refunds reference the corresponding payment and return request.

title: Requirement 27
text: Refund amount must be less than or equal to original payment amount.

title: Requirement 28
text: Order cancellations record actor and cancellation timestamp.

title: Requirement 29
text: Delivery events store event type and event time per shipment.

title: Requirement 30
text: Audit entries capture actor, action type, and timestamp for order lifecycle events.
